title: Nabi ki jaan dile
body:
nabi ki jaan dil e hyder ka aaj chehlum hai
makeen e dosh e payamber ka aaj chehlum hai
ke ibne faatah e khyber ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar ka aaj chehlum hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jhulasti rayt pa afsoos pyaas mein tadpa
shaheed ho gaya maqtal mein phool sa bacha
usi hussain ke dilbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bahoo ashkon ko aur momino karo girya
dilao fateha aur majlisein karo barpa
hamare mohsin o yawar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ne raahe khuda mein kata diya sar ko
wo jis ne raahe khuda mein luta diya ghar ko
us ibne saaqi e kausar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen roti hai aansu baha raha hai falak
libaas e gham mein pareshan sabhi hai jinn o malak
ye ro ke kehte hai dilbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
rawan hai bachon pa afsos zulm ke khanjar
pachade khaati thi zainab ye dekh kar manzar
musibaton ke samandar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jis ki laash ko raunda sitam ne maqtal mein
wo jis ki bewa bahaati thi ashk jangal mein
yateem saani e shabbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek khwaab baha zulm ki rawani mein
sina kaleje pa khaayi bhari jawani mein
hussain ke usi akbar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aaj shiyon mohamed o aun ka chehlum
hussain ibne ali ki hai jaan ka chehlum
habeeb jaise dilawar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
raza furaat pa apne kata ke shaano ko
hayaat de gaya ghazi wafa ki raahon ko
usi wafaon ke paikar ka aaj chehlum hai
bahao ashk ke sarwar...
author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi
